text: Provides generalized linear models panel data, including pooled, fixed-effects, random-effects estimators continuous, binary, count, ordinal, positive (gamma), bounded (beta) outcomes, fixed-effects ordered logit Baetschmann, Staub Winkelmann (2015) doi:10.1111/rssa.12090  beta regression (Ferrari Cribari-Neto 2004) doi:10.1080/0266476042000214501 . Estimators tests follow standard panel-data references, including Hausman (1978) doi:10.2307/1913827 , Chamberlain (1980) doi:10.2307/2297110 , Allison Waterman (2002) doi:10.1111/1467-9531.00117 , Croissant Millo (2008) doi:10.18637/jss.v027.i02 . title: panglm 1.6.1
text: Random-intercept binomial (logit, probit) ordered (logit, probit) models now integrated adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature centred individual’s mode, instead non-adaptive quadrature. Estimates change, large random-effect variances long panels. default R = 21 fits match lme4::glmer(nAGQ = 21) ordinal::clmm(nAGQ = 21) 1e-5; R = 1 now Laplace approximation (glmmTMB, clmm(nAGQ = 1)). panqr(model = "mmqr"): analytic covariance (vcov = "analytic", default) now cluster-robust individual. influence functions location, scale quantile steps summed within cluster V = G/(G-1) sum_g psi_g psi_g', G number clusters. formula Machado Santos Silva (2019), assumes independent observations can badly overstate standard errors short panels, kept vcov = "iid". new cluster argument names another clustering column. Standard errors existing MM-QR fits change. Gaussian random effects unbalanced panels now use Swamy-Arora variance components plm (random.method = "swar"), estimates unbalanced panels change match plm::plm(model = "random"). Balanced fits unchanged. negative individual-effect variance set zero warning. one-way two-way fixed-effects logit fitted Newton-Raphson exact analytic Hessian conditional likelihood instead BFGS finite-difference Hessian. Coefficients standard errors match survival::clogit() 1e-13, fit faster clogit N = 10,000 50,000.
